blog_title: ₹40 Polyester T-Shirt for DTF Printing — Why 300 Pcs Bubbled and 50 Orders Got Returned
caption:
300 pieces ordered. Print looked perfect. Then the buyer said it felt cheap. 😬

Fabric was fine. Print was fine. But the stitching? That's where ₹85 and ₹200 tees split.

Chain stitch vs lock stitch on hems. Flat-locked vs rough side seams. One survives 10 washes. One doesn't.

Save this post before your next bulk order 👇
